Nina: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands. Leadership wants concrete customer-friendly dates for: (1) Console traffic controls (UI + API), and (2) Optimize's tuning recommendations (batching + quantization). Can product give single-line summaries + caveats?

Sam (Product): Console traffic controls: private beta targeted 2026-05-18, public beta targeted week of 2026-06-22. Caveat: depends on quota backend migration; if migration slips, expect ~1 week delay.

Diego (Runtime): Staging migration is at 5/6 services. If staging rollback is triggered we'll lose ~1 week. Flagging risk.

Priya (DevEx): I'll prepare a short migration FAQ and SDK snippet (example route-limit call) by Friday.

Sam (Product): Optimize recommendations: internal alpha early May for a few customers, public beta mid-July. Hosted-only at launch; Dedicated validation planned for August (Q3). Recommendations include a confidence score and a safety flag if evals detect quality drops.

Liam (Sales): A couple of prospects asked for Dedicated support sooner. Can we give them a month for Q3 (tentative)?

Diego (Runtime): Tentative Dedicated support target: August. We'll need Dedicated smoke tests for quantized models on A100/T4 variants.

eval-bot: Eval harness run queued (id: 20260501-73). Estimated 30m.

ops-bot: Quota migration staging status: 5/6 services migrated, health checks green; canary cutover estimated 2026-05-10.

Sam (Product): Customer-ready one liners: "Console traffic controls (UI + API): private beta mid-May, public beta late June; dependent on quota backend migration (possible ~1 week delay)." / "Optimize recommendations (batching + quantization): internal alpha early May, public beta mid-July; hosted-only initially, Dedicated support planned for August after smoke validation; recommendations include confidence & safety signals."

Priya (DevEx): I'll convert Sam's lines into a short FAQ + SDK examples and open a docs PR Monday.

Liam (Sales): I'll wait for the FAQ before outreach. If docs are up Mon/Tue I can brief accounts mid-week.

Nina: Action items: Priya publish FAQ, Diego monitor migration and flag slips, Sam update roadmap and tag owners, Liam hold outreach. We'll reconvene if timelines move. :thumbsup:
